blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Three Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) officials in Davao City have been relieved from their posts amid a National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) probe into alleged irregularities in the city’s flood control projects, Secretary Vince Dizon said Monday.
